doc_metadata.notes: Appendix C1 specifies minimum qualification requirements for learning and development programs and assessments. Document establishes supplier eligibility gates for organizational experience and resource capacity.
doc_metadata.title: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, learning and organizational development services

evaluation_criteria.notes: Two mandatory qualification gates must be satisfied for proponent eligibility. Both organizational experience and dedicated resource capacity are pass/fail conditions.

evaluation_criteria.threshold: Pass/Fail (Yes/No confirmation required for each criterion)
evaluation_criteria.title: Minimum Qualification Gate

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory pass/fail qualification criterion. Proponent must confirm established firm status and prior delivery experience.

source_refs.excerpt: Organizational Experience (Minimum Five (5) Years) Proponent must confirm that it is an established firm and has delivered at least three (3) organization-wide learning and development engagements of similar scope and complexity within the last five (5) years for organizations with a minimum of 1,000 employees.

evaluation_criteria.threshold: Minimum three (3) organization-wide engagements of similar scope and complexity within last five (5) years for organizations with minimum 1,000 employees
evaluation_criteria.title: Organizational Experience (Minimum Five (5) Years)

evaluation_criteria.notes: Mandatory pass/fail qualification criterion. Proponent must confirm availability of specified staffing resources.

source_refs.excerpt: Dedicated Resource Capacity Proponent must confirm they have a minimum of five (5) qualified learning and development professionals available to deliver services under the agreement, including at least one senior curriculum designer and one senior facilitator.
